VALIDATION_ERROR.description: One or more input fields failed validation rules
VALIDATION_ERROR.resolution: Review validation errors in response details and correct input data.

REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING.message: Required field is missing or empty
REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING.description: A mandatory field was not provided or was empty
commonCauses: Form submitted with empty required fields
Null or undefined values sent for required fields
REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING.resolution: Provide valid values for all required fields indicated in the error details.

INVALID_FORMAT.description: Field value does not match the expected format or pattern
INVALID_FORMAT.resolution: Ensure field values match the documented format requirements.

INVALID_DATE_RANGE.message: Date range is invalid or end date is before start date
INVALID_DATE_RANGE.description: Date range validation failed (end date before start date, or invalid date values)
commonCauses: End date is before start date
INVALID_DATE_RANGE.resolution: Ensure end date is after start date and all dates are valid.

FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.message: File type is not allowed for upload
FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.description: Uploaded file type is not permitted for this endpoint
commonCauses: File extension not in allowed list
FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.resolution: Upload files with allowed extensions (typically: PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, JPG, PNG).

FILE_SIZE_EXCEEDED.message: File size exceeds maximum allowed limit
FILE_SIZE_EXCEEDED.description: Uploaded file exceeds the maximum allowed size limit
FILE_SIZE_EXCEEDED.resolution: Reduce file size through compression or splitting, or use alternative file formats.

AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.description: User provided invalid login credentials (username/email and password combination)
AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.resolution: Verify credentials and try again. Use password reset if needed.

TOKEN_EXPIRED.description: The JWT authentication token has exceeded its validity period
TOKEN_EXPIRED.resolution: Use refresh token to obtain new access token or re-authenticate.

TOKEN_INVALID.message: Authentication token is invalid or malformed
TOKEN_INVALID.description: The provided JWT token is malformed, corrupted, or has invalid signature
TOKEN_INVALID.resolution: Obtain a fresh token through authentication.

TOKEN_MISSING.description: No authentication token was provided in the request
commonCauses: Client not configured to send auth headers
TOKEN_MISSING.resolution: Include valid JWT token in Authorization header as "Bearer <token>".

AUTHORIZATION_FAILED.message: Insufficient permissions to access this resource
AUTHORIZATION_FAILED.description: User lacks the necessary permissions to perform the requested action
commonCauses: User role does not have required permission
AUTHORIZATION_FAILED.resolution: Contact administrator to verify role and permissions, or use an account with appropriate access level.

TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED.message: Access to this tenant data is not permitted
TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED.description: User attempted to access data outside their assigned tenant/organization
TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED.resolution: Ensure requests target resources within your organization. Verify tenant context.

ROLE_PERMISSION_DENIED.message: User role does not have required permissions
ROLE_PERMISSION_DENIED.description: Specific role-based permission check failed for the current user
ROLE_PERMISSION_DENIED.resolution: Re-authenticate to refresh permissions, or contact administrator for role verification.

RESOURCE_OWNER_ONLY.message: Only the resource owner can perform this action
RESOURCE_OWNER_ONLY.description: Action can only be performed by the resource owner
commonCauses: Attempting to modify another user's personal data
RESOURCE_OWNER_ONLY.resolution: Only the resource owner or users with elevated permissions can perform this action.

USER_NOT_FOUND.description: Requested user account does not exist in the system
commonCauses: Incorrect user ID or email provided
USER_NOT_FOUND.resolution: Verify user identifier and ensure user exists in current tenant context.

CLIENT_NOT_FOUND.description: Specified client organization does not exist
commonCauses: Access to client restricted by permissions
CLIENT_NOT_FOUND.resolution: Verify client ID and check client status with administrator.

SITE_NOT_FOUND.description: Requested security site location does not exist
SITE_NOT_FOUND.resolution: Confirm site ID and check if site is still active.

EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND.description: Employee record does not exist in the system
EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND.resolution: Verify employee ID and employment status.

ASSIGNMENT_NOT_FOUND.description: Assignment record does not exist in the system
ASSIGNMENT_NOT_FOUND.resolution: Verify assignment ID and check assignment status.

SHIFT_NOT_FOUND.description: Shift record does not exist in the system
SHIFT_NOT_FOUND.resolution: Verify shift ID and check current shift schedule.

ATTENDANCE_NOT_FOUND.description: Attendance record does not exist for the specified parameters
commonCauses: No attendance recorded for the date/employee
ATTENDANCE_NOT_FOUND.resolution: Verify attendance parameters and check if attendance was recorded.

PAYROLL_NOT_FOUND.description: Payroll run does not exist for the specified period
commonCauses: Payroll not yet generated for period
PAYROLL_NOT_FOUND.resolution: Verify payroll run ID and pay period dates.

INVOICE_NOT_FOUND.description: Invoice record does not exist in the system
INVOICE_NOT_FOUND.resolution: Verify invoice ID and check invoice generation status.

EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS.description: Email address is already registered in the system
commonCauses: User attempting to register with existing email
Email used by archived or deactivated account
Email case sensitivity ignored by system
EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS.resolution: Use a different email address or recover existing account.

EMPLOYEE_ID_DUPLICATE.description: Employee ID already exists in the system
commonCauses: Attempting to create employee with existing ID
ID format collision with existing employee
EMPLOYEE_ID_DUPLICATE.resolution: Use a unique employee ID or update existing employee record.

SHIFT_CONFLICT.message: Employee is already assigned to another shift at this time
SHIFT_CONFLICT.description: Employee is already assigned to another shift at this time
commonCauses: Double-booking employee for same time slot
SHIFT_CONFLICT.resolution: Resolve scheduling conflict by adjusting shift times or reassigning employee.

ATTENDANCE_ALREADY_EXISTS.message: Attendance record already exists for this shift
ATTENDANCE_ALREADY_EXISTS.description: Attendance record already exists for this shift
ATTENDANCE_ALREADY_EXISTS.resolution: Update existing attendance record instead of creating new one.

PAYROLL_ALREADY_FINALIZED.message: Payroll run is already finalized and cannot be modified
PAYROLL_ALREADY_FINALIZED.description: Payroll run is already finalized and cannot be modified
PAYROLL_ALREADY_FINALIZED.resolution: Create adjustment in next payroll period or request payroll reopening.

INVOICE_ALREADY_PAID.message: Invoice is already marked as paid
INVOICE_ALREADY_PAID.description: Invoice is already marked as paid
INVOICE_ALREADY_PAID.resolution: Verify payment status or create credit note if payment reversal needed.

SKILL_MISMATCH.message: Employee skills do not match site requirements
SKILL_MISMATCH.description: Employee skills do not meet the requirements for the assigned site or shift
SKILL_MISMATCH.resolution: Update employee skills/certifications or assign to appropriate site.

INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE.message: Insufficient guard coverage for site requirements
INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE.description: Not enough qualified guards assigned to meet site security requirements
INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE.resolution: Add more qualified employees to the shift or adjust site requirements.

PAYROLL_CALCULATION_ERROR.description: Error occurred during automated payroll processing
PAYROLL_CALCULATION_ERROR.resolution: Review employee time records and rate settings, then recalculate payroll.

INVALID_WORK_HOURS.message: Work hours exceed maximum allowed limits
INVALID_WORK_HOURS.description: Work hours exceed maximum allowed limits
commonCauses: Employee logged more than daily limit
INVALID_WORK_HOURS.resolution: Adjust work hours to comply with labor regulations and company policies.

ATTENDANCE_TIME_INVALID.message: Clock-out time cannot be before clock-in time
ATTENDANCE_TIME_INVALID.description: Clock-out time cannot be before clock-in time
ATTENDANCE_TIME_INVALID.resolution: Correct the attendance times to ensure clock-in is before clock-out.

GPS_VERIFICATION_FAILED.message: GPS location verification failed for attendance
GPS_VERIFICATION_FAILED.description: GPS location verification failed for attendance
commonCauses: Employee not at designated work location
GPS_VERIFICATION_FAILED.resolution: Ensure employee is at correct location or adjust geofence settings.

RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message: Request rate limit exceeded. Please try again later
RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: Request rate limit exceeded for the current user or IP address
commonCauses: Too many requests in short time period
RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.resolution: Wait for rate limit window to reset or implement exponential backoff.

TOO_MANY_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS.message: Too many login attempts. Account temporarily locked
TOO_MANY_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS.description: Account temporarily locked due to excessive failed login attempts
TOO_MANY_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS.resolution: Wait for lockout period to expire or use password reset functionality.

INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.message: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later
INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.description: Unexpected system error occurred during request processing
INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.resolution: Try request again later. If problem persists, contact technical support with error ID.

DATABASE_ERROR.description: Database operation failed due to system or connectivity issues
DATABASE_ERROR.resolution: Retry request after brief delay. Check system status or contact support if persistent.

EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR.description: Integration with external service (payment, email, etc.) failed
EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR.resolution: Check service status and retry. May need to use alternative methods temporarily.

ENCRYPTION_ERROR.description: Data encryption or decryption process failed
ENCRYPTION_ERROR.resolution: Verify encryption configuration and retry. Contact support if persistent.

AUDIT_LOG_ERROR.message: Failed to write audit log entry
AUDIT_LOG_ERROR.description: Failed to write audit log entry for the operation
AUDIT_LOG_ERROR.resolution: Operation may have succeeded but not logged. Check system status.
